messages:
nora: Heads-up: starting staggered deploy for v2.5.0 in 8m (change window 15:00-16:00 UTC). Canary id cb-4721. Key notes: DB schema toggle is behind flag, but service config changes + model shard placement included. Rollback/runbook links -> https://runbooks.internal/deploy/rollback-v2 and https://runbooks.internal/deploy/evacuate. Fallback commit: 78b9cde. @eng-oncall @raj please ack and stand by.

deploy-bot: Canary cb-4721 scheduled: 2026-04-02T15:02Z -> 5% us-east-1. To abort: `/deploybot abort cb-4721` or `/deploybot rollback cb-4721 --to 78b9cde`. Requires release-approver or oncall. Metrics: https://dd.internal/dashboards/cb-4721.

raj: ack. I'll run the smoke harness and keep logs open. Alert thresholds: 4xx+5xx >4% sustained 3m OR p95 > 700ms -> abort.

claire: noted. QA will do a quick verification on critical flows at +4m. Post any user facing issues here.

eng-oncall: I've got the evacuation runbook pulled. Quick checklist summary for backout: 1) `/deploybot abort` 2) pin configs -> ops-configs pin 78b9cde 3) flip feature-flag off for db toggle 4) `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api` and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/worker` 5) flush CDN and connection pools. Also open pager if >10% 5xx.

nora: if aborting, also revert the model shard placement in S3 (s3://configs/model-shards/prod.json) to prior. That caused stale cache hits in the last run.

raj: canary live +3m. Initial p50=110ms, p95=420ms, errorRate=0.6% :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: cb-4721 -> state=healthy at 2026-04-02T15:05Z.

claire: QA smoke passed for payments flow. No regressions so far.

raj: small blip at 15:10Z: p95 spikes to ~820ms for 90s, traced to a tail lat in the inference worker queue. Error rate unchanged. I'm throttling worker concurrency for the canary subset and watching.

eng-oncall: hold pattern: watch 5m. If p95 > 800ms for 2 consecutive minutes or errorRate >2% for 3m, we abort. Do NOT hotpatch config during canary without ops sig.

nora: agreed. I'll pause increasing traffic.

raj: 15:13Z metrics improved after throttling. p95 back to 480ms. Still under tolerance.

claire: still green on QA. Suggest we move to 25% in 10m if stable. Anyone object?

eng-oncall: roll to 25% scheduled. Reminder: if we abort, include a small incident note in the runbook timeline and tag release-approver.

deploy-bot: Increasing cb-4721 to 25% at 2026-04-02T15:22Z as requested by eng-oncall.

raj: after roll to 25%, we saw a gradual increase in connection errors from one DB pool (pool-3). Error rate rose to 1.9% at 15:28Z. Taking a closer look.

eng-oncall: 15:30Z decision: start abort sequence. Criteria met: localized DB pool errors + rising tail lat. Steps being executed now.

nora: executing ops checklist: pin ops-configs to 78b9cde, running `/deploybot abort cb-4721` now.

deploy-bot: Received abort for cb-4721 from nora. Stopping traffic and initiating rollback to 78b9cde. See logs: https://dd.internal/logs/cb-4721/abort.

claire: confirming QA scope reverted. Running a brief sanity smoke.

eng-oncall: running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=45` and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/worker --to-revision=30`. Flushing caches and CDN purge started.

raj: DB pool issue isolated to a recent connection string change in the canary config. Reverting that in parallel with rollback.

nora: model shard file reverted in S3 and invalidated. Also toggled off DB migration flag.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 2026-04-02T15:37Z. cb-4721 -> state=rolled_back. Traffic restored to pre-canary routing.

eng-oncall: Post-abort checks: p50=95ms, p95=300ms, errorRate=0.4%. Opening short postmortem and linking runbook timeline. Postmortem draft: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/pm-4721.

claire: filing QA notes into the postmortem. Recommend blocking model-shard changes from landing during a change window without a separate validation job.

raj: I'll prepare a safe-hotfix branch with the DB pool fix and coordinate a controlled redeploy after we validate in staging.

nora: thanks team. Closing thread after we merge the postmortem and update the rollback runbook with the DB pool item.

eng-oncall: thread closed. TL;DR: abort executed per runbook, rolled back to 78b9cde, follow-up actions documented.
